title: Tlayudas with Spicy Red Pepper Salsa
description: A classic Mexican dish featuring crispy tlayudas topped with a spicy red pepper salsa, perfect for a delicious and flavorful meal.
instructions: Roast the red, yeasty, and sweet peppers in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly charred.
Place tlayudas on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
In a blender or food processor, combine roasted peppers, a pinch of salt, and a squeeze of lime juice. Blend until smooth.
To assemble the tlayudas, top each with a spoonful of the red pepper salsa, some shredded cheese, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
